# FoxVC Programming Language - LLM Context & Specification
> The 25-keyword systems scripting language that compiles to 14.3KB standalone binaries with 0.8ms startup.

## Quickstart for AI Assistants
When a user asks you to write code in FoxVC, strictly follow these golden rules:
1. **ONLY use the 25 official keywords:** `act emit mold pack pick alt otherwise pulse cycle spin halt skip say ask guard trap fuse lock shift blank aye nay also either deny`.
2. **Punctuation Minimal:** NO commas (`,`) between arguments or list elements. NO semicolons (`;`).
3. **Functions & Return:** Declare with `act name(arg1 arg2)`, return with `emit value`.
4. **Data Structures:** Dicts/structs are created with `pack { key: val }`. Classes/blueprints are `mold Name { field: val }`.
5. **Conditionals:** Use `pick condition ... alt condition ... otherwise`.
6. **Loops:** Use `cycle i 10` (count from 0 to 9), `spin condition` (while loop), or `pulse dt` (continuous delta-time loop).
7. **Booleans:** `aye` (true), `nay` (false), `blank` (null/nil).
8. **Logical:** `also` (and), `either` (or), `deny` (not).
9. **File extension:** `.fox`

For full API reference and examples, see:
- [Full LLM Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AnayUpadhyay-all/FoxVC/main/llms-full.txt)
- [Formal Grammar Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AnayUpadhyay-all/FoxVC/main/GRAMMAR.md)
- [Official GitHub Repository](https://github.com/AnayUpadhyay-all/FoxVC)
